fields.name: DISC
fields.description: DISC is a behavior assessment tool based on four behavioral traits: Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness.

fields.name: Big Five
fields.description: The Big Five personality traits (OCEAN) are the best accepted and most commonly used model of personality in academic psychology.

fields.name: Dominance
fields.description: How you respond to problems and challenges. High D individuals are results-oriented, direct, and competitive.

fields.name: Influence
fields.description: How you influence others. High I individuals are enthusiastic, collaborative, and optimistic.

fields.name: Steadiness
fields.description: How you respond to pace and consistency. High S individuals are patient, reliable, and team-oriented.

fields.name: Conscientiousness
fields.description: How you respond to rules and procedures. High C individuals are analytical, systematic, and quality-focused.

fields.name: Openness
fields.description: Openness to experience. Reflects the degree of intellectual curiosity, creativity, and preference for novelty.

fields.name: Conscientiousness
fields.description: Tendency to be organized and dependable, show self-discipline, and act dutifully.

fields.name: Extraversion
fields.description: Energy, positive emotions, and the tendency to seek stimulation in the company of others.

fields.name: Agreeableness
fields.description: Tendency to be compassionate and cooperative rather than suspicious and antagonistic towards others.

fields.name: Neuroticism
fields.description: Tendency to experience unpleasant emotions easily, such as anger, anxiety, depression, and vulnerability.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Collaborative
fields.interpretive_text: You tend to prefer working cooperatively and may avoid direct confrontation. You value group harmony and consensus-building over asserting individual authority.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Balanced
fields.interpretive_text: You balance assertiveness with cooperation. You can take charge when needed but also know when to collaborate and defer to others.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Decisive
fields.interpretive_text: You are results-oriented, assertive, and direct. You take initiative, make decisions quickly, and thrive in competitive environments where you can drive outcomes.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Reserved
fields.interpretive_text: You prefer working independently and may find large group settings draining. You tend to be more analytical and task-focused in your approach to others.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Adaptable
fields.interpretive_text: You are comfortable in both social and independent work settings. You can be persuasive and enthusiastic when needed, while also focusing on task completion.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Enthusiastic
fields.interpretive_text: You are outgoing, persuasive, and energized by people. You excel at building relationships, motivating others, and creating positive team energy. You thrive in collaborative and social environments.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Dynamic
fields.interpretive_text: You embrace change and variety. You may thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments and can adapt quickly to new situations and shifting priorities.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Flexible
fields.interpretive_text: You balance stability with adaptability. You can work effectively in both structured and changing environments, maintaining reliability while remaining open to new approaches.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Dependable
fields.interpretive_text: You are patient, consistent, and highly reliable. You build strong, long-term relationships and are the anchor of your team. You excel in environments that value stability and steady execution.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Instinctive
fields.interpretive_text: You rely on intuition and big-picture thinking over detailed analysis. You move quickly and may delegate details to others, prioritizing speed and momentum over perfection.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Pragmatic
fields.interpretive_text: You balance thoroughness with practicality. You apply systematic thinking when the stakes are high but can also move quickly when needed without getting lost in details.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Analytical
fields.interpretive_text: You are detail-oriented, systematic, and precise. You set high standards and ensure quality through careful analysis. You are most comfortable when you have clear processes, accurate data, and time to think things through.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Conventional
fields.interpretive_text: You prefer tried-and-true methods and established routines. You are practical and focused, bringing consistency and reliability to your work.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Curious
fields.interpretive_text: You balance creativity with pragmatism. You enjoy exploring new ideas when they serve a clear purpose, while maintaining a practical grounding in your approach.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Inventive
fields.interpretive_text: You are highly curious, imaginative, and intellectually engaged. You seek out new experiences, enjoy abstract thinking, and thrive in environments that value creativity and innovation.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Spontaneous
fields.interpretive_text: You are flexible and adaptable, often preferring to respond to situations as they arise rather than following rigid plans. You may prioritize exploration over structure.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Organized
fields.interpretive_text: You balance structure with flexibility. You can organize and plan effectively when needed, while remaining adaptable when circumstances change.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Disciplined
fields.interpretive_text: You are highly organized, dependable, and self-disciplined. You set high standards, follow through on commitments, and excel in roles requiring meticulous planning and execution.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Introverted
fields.interpretive_text: You recharge through solitude and prefer depth over breadth in your relationships. You bring thoughtful, focused energy to your work and may find large social settings draining.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Ambivert
fields.interpretive_text: You move comfortably between social engagement and independent work. You can energize a room when needed and also focus deeply when working alone.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Extraverted
fields.interpretive_text: You are sociable, energetic, and thrive in team environments. You bring enthusiasm and energy to group settings and are energized by interaction with others.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Independent
fields.interpretive_text: You are direct, skeptical, and comfortable with conflict when necessary. You prioritize objectivity and may challenge assumptions rather than accommodating others by default.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Cooperative
fields.interpretive_text: You balance directness with empathy. You can assert your views confidently while remaining sensitive to the needs and feelings of those around you.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Harmonious
fields.interpretive_text: You are warm, empathetic, and deeply collaborative. You prioritize group harmony and are skilled at building trust and resolving conflicts. You bring a compassionate and supportive presence to your team.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Resilient
fields.interpretive_text: You are emotionally stable and calm under pressure. You handle stress effectively and rarely allow setbacks to disrupt your performance or mood.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: Sensitive
fields.interpretive_text: You experience a normal range of emotional responses. You can feel stress or frustration under pressure, but generally recover and manage your emotional state effectively.

fields.name: high
fields.label: Reactive
fields.interpretive_text: You experience emotions intensely and may be more sensitive to stress, criticism, or uncertainty than others. Building routines and support systems can help you channel this emotional richness productively.
